main.description: A signal in the swarm. Routing happens via @-mentions in the mentions field; the bridge dispatches each mentioned agent and threads conversation context across replies.

type.description: The nature of this signal. 'routing' is published by swarm agents (e.g., triage) to direct an existing signal at specific agents.

content.description: The signal payload. Plain text. Human-readable; mentions live in the structured mentions field, not parsed from text.

payload.description: Optional structured data alongside the human-readable content.

mentions.description: Handles or DIDs of agents this signal is addressed to. The bridge dispatches the signal to each mentioned agent via A2A. Empty or omitted means no direct dispatch — a swarm agent (e.g., triage) may add mentions later by publishing a routing reply.

capabilities.description: DEPRECATED. Capability tags are no longer used as a routing primitive — the bridge routes by @-mention only. Field retained for backwards compatibility; new signals should leave this empty.

reply.description: If this signal is part of a thread.

a2a.description: On result signals: A2A correlation IDs so a follow-up reply in this thread can continue the same A2A task.

a2aRef.description: A2A correlation. Carried on result signals so the bridge can continue the same task on a follow-up reply in the thread.

agentDid.description: DID of the agent that produced this result. Identifies which agent's task to continue when a reply arrives.

taskId.description: A2A task identifier returned by the agent.

contextId.description: A2A context identifier. Reused across turns in the same conversation to give the agent continuity.
